meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描项目文件的扩展名来识别语言，然后安装并配置对应的语言服务器，最后实际运行一次诊断验证配置，使编辑器的诊断、跳转定义、查找引用等功能可用。
howto.when: 当你要配置 LSP、安装语言服务器，或修复“无 LSP 服务器配置/未安装”的错误时触发；也用于在多个服务器方案间选择。

say.text: 帮我配置 Python 的语言服务器
say.note: Claude 会按 Python 参考文档安装并配置服务器。

say.text: 修复这个项目没有 LSP 服务器的问题
say.note: Claude 会检测语言并自动完成安装、配置与验证。

say.text: 我想用 ruff 替代 pyright，怎么改配置？
say.note: Claude 会给出配置片段并验证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project's file extensions to identify languages, installs and configures the corresponding language server, then runs a real diagnostics roundtrip to verify the setup, making editor features like diagnostics and go-to-definition work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to configure LSP, install/set up a language server, or fix 'no LSP server configured/not installed' errors; also for choosing between server options.

say_en.text: Set up the language server for Python
say_en.note: Claude follows the Python reference to install and configure it.

say_en.text: Fix the missing LSP server for this project
say_en.note: Claude detects languages and runs install, config, and verification.

say_en.text: How do I switch from pyright to ruff in the config?
say_en.note: Claude provides the config snippet and verifies it.
